user.title: NFC Ring
user.description: Receives scans from NFC rings in your Thread network (UDP port 5683) and reports them as tag scans. Scanned tags appear under Settings → Tags.

data.show_panel: Show the "NFC Ring" overview page in the sidebar

data_description.show_panel: Lists rings, tags and the automations they trigger. Can be changed at any time under "Configure".

abort.single_instance_allowed: NFC Ring is already set up.

init.title: NFC Ring
init.description: The overview page shows rings, tags and their automations. Switching it off only removes the sidebar entry. A new ring is paired with the code from its packaging, on the overview page or here.

data.show_panel: Show the "NFC Ring" overview page in the sidebar
data.pairing_code: Pairing code of a new ring (optional)

data_description.pairing_code: 20 characters, e.g. ABCDE-12345-FGHJK-67890. If the ring has not reported yet, it is paired as soon as it does within the next 10 minutes.

error.invalid_code: This is not a pairing code: it has 20 characters (digits and letters).
error.pairing_failed: Pairing is not possible. Is the integration running, and are fewer than 16 rings set up?
